decisions.title: Move skills start-up logic out of index.ts
decisions.step: Add RunStartUpChecksUseCase (runs StartSkills + ReadCredentials, saves the result to a new in-memory StartUpCheckResults port) and ReadRunsBlockedUseCase. InstallPluginLocally waits through that port. index.ts only maps methods to use cases.

decisions.title: GitHubToken is not a logic port
decisions.step: Move the GitHubToken interface from watcher/logic/ports into watcher/infra; only infra uses it. Keep it in watcher, not shared: no second module needs it.

decisions.title: One shared gh runner
decisions.step: Move scheduler's runGhCommand to shared/ (e.g. shared/github) and use it from projects, scheduler and findings. Four modules already spawn gh with their own timeout and error handling.

decisions.title: Keep ReadRunAvailability and ReadTicketRun in scheduler
decisions.step: No change. Optional later: rename ReadRunAvailability to show it is the start gate.

decisions.title: Move ReadTicketSessionLog to runner
decisions.step: Fold it into runner's ReadSessionLog (now ticket-keyed; runner.sessionLog has no other caller). Move the session-log route to runner, URL unchanged. Drop sessionLog from scheduler's RunnerPort. Name still open: ReadTicketRunLog or ReadTicketSessionLog.

decisions.title: Rename ReadPageState / WritePageState
decisions.step: Rename both use cases, the _state route handlers and FileSystemArtifactFiles' readState/writeState. Name still open: …PageUserInputState or …PageDraft.

decisions.title: Rename bridge module to artifacts
decisions.step: Carried over. If yes: rename the folder, factory, main.ts wiring, project-architecture and the plugin artifacts skill wording; keep kit bridge.js.

decisions.title: Tighten the module-split rule
decisions.step: Carried over from round 1. Make 'almost no logic' and 'core business logic' testable, and add when a split is due.
